name: flowforge
description: FlowForge — a scalable, real-time project management SaaS (MERN, TypeScript, Socket.IO, Redis, MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flowforge/api" "npm run dev -w @flowforge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowforge/api && npm run build -w @flowforge/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flowforge/api && npm run test -w @flowforge/web
